title: hurdle after hurdle: getting to know neocities
content:
now i know how the source code looks, but this was the best i could do at the moment. i really did not want to make my blog posts via editing a html file and i just realised that neocities actually does not support php! this was the second best thing i came up with.

of course this is probably not the best approach and as a prolific vibecoder, i could have done better. but it gets the job done right now. i wonder how this thing will react to code snippets and images...

i am not really sure how frequent my activity on here will be, but rest assured that i will not post dogshit.

let's take a moment to appreciate this particular snippet of code:

const emailSpan = document.querySelector('.email');
if (emailSpan) {
    emailSpan.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const email = this.getAttribute('data-email');
        copyToClipboard(email, 'email copied');
    });
}

sorry this post is completely incoherent but i wanted to test shit out!!! works like a charm
